about: The Toolbelt: every tool of the Looped engine in one list (docs/UI_PLAN.md R1.1). The page /toolbelt/ draws it; tools/toolbelt_test.mjs checks it. A new tool: one entry here.

tools.name: Studio
tools.what: Build, move and light anything in the world. Every version kept.

tools.name: UI Editor
tools.what: Themes and screens for the site, Dev, the bar's menus and the engine.

tools.name: Screens
tools.what: See any screen file drawn in the current theme.

tools.name: Dials
tools.what: Every number in the world as a dial: light, sound, feel.

tools.name: World notes
tools.what: What each thing in the world does, its states and rules.

tools.name: The live bar
tools.what: Walk the floor. Add ?perf=1 for the frame meter and Send report.

tools.name: Perf report
tools.what: Open a phone report by its six-letter code.

tools.name: Tests and deploys
tools.what: Every test run and deploy on GitHub.

tools.name: Gallery
tools.what: Before and after pictures of every piece.

tools.name: Bar3D classic
tools.what: The old public build, kept as it was.

tools.name: Engine flags
tools.what: Switch engine features on and off, like ?light=classic or ?bounce=0.

tools.name: Piece runner
tools.what: One piece: build, check, pictures, commit, push.

tools.name: Step finisher
tools.what: The end of a step: full check, deploy, build log.

tools.name: Checks
tools.what: PASS or FAIL per system, with the first error lines.

tools.name: World sync
tools.what: Brings the world you published into the repo, and back.

tools.name: UI kit
tools.what: Writes the theme CSS from the theme files (css) and checks they agree (check).

tools.name: Benchmarks
tools.what: Engine speed numbers, each against the last run.

tools.name: Light tool
tools.what: Checks and bakes the world's light.
